speaker: CHIEF JUSTICE ROBERTS
text: Justice Alito has the opinion of the court in two cases this morning. The first is

speaker: JUSTICE ALITO
text: Abatron versus Hetronic. Sections 32 and 43 of the Lanamack prohibit the unauthorized use in commerce of protected trademarks when the use is likely to cause confusion. After a trial, a company called Hetronic International received a large damages award on claims that five foreign entities infringed its trademark rights both domestically and globally. We granted certiorari to review the 10th Circuit's affirmance and based on the presumption against extraterritoriality, we now vacate the judgment and remain the case for further proceedings. Justice Jackson has filed a concurring opinion. Justice Sotomayor has filed an opinion concurring in the judgment which is joined by the Chief Justice, Justice Kagan and Justice Barrett.
